Title: Yellowing Lower Leaves on Tomato Plants
Summary: Yellow lower tomato leaves traced to overwatering or nitrogen shortage; advised drying soil between waterings, fertilising, and removing yellow leaves.

Title: Laptop battery drain during Linux suspend
Summary: Overnight suspend drain traced to s2idle-only sleep; no S3 available, so BIOS sleep-state setting and USB wake sources are next checks.
